categories.name: Playable Character Roster
categories.description: Unlock all 8 mid-boss rivals, the final boss Heihachi Mishima, and alternate costume Devil Kazuya (17 characters total).

categories.name: Arcade Story Campaigns
categories.description: Complete Arcade mode without character switching on Medium difficulty or higher across all 17 fighters.

categories.name: Combos & Technical Execution
categories.description: Execute universal 3-hit and 10-hit combinations, along with character-specific 6-hit combos for all 17 fighters.

categories.name: Difficulty & Endurance Trials
categories.description: Finish Arcade mode on Hard, Ultra Hard, under 5 minutes (speedrun), and a grueling 5-round marathon without continues.

playthrough_notes: Tekken (PS1) is a 3D fighting game where 100% completion requires completing individual Arcade mode campaigns across all characters, practicing combos in Versus Mode or Arcade Mode, clearing the Galaga loading mini-game, and tackling specific difficulty/endurance parameters. No achievements are permanently missable or mutually exclusive, as individual Arcade runs and VS Mode matches can be attempted at any time.
settings_notes: Default settings: Difficulty Medium, Round Count 3, Round Time 40. Individual achievements require adjusting Difficulty to Ultra Hard (for 90422/90423) or Round Count to 5 (for 90429).

chapters.title: Boot Challenge & Core Combat Fundamentals
chapters.notes: Clear all 8 stages of Galaga with <=1 continue during loading to unlock Devil Kazuya. Establish basic controls, achieve a Perfect victory in Arcade mode, and perform 3-hit and 10-hit combos in VS Mode against an idle 2P controller.

chapters.title: The Original Eight: Base Roster Campaigns & Sub-Boss Unlocks
chapters.notes: Clear Arcade mode on Medium difficulty (default settings, no character change) with each of the 8 base fighters, defeating their Stage 8 rivals to unlock all 8 sub-bosses. Execute each character's signature 6-hit combo during their run or in VS Mode.

chapters.title: The Sub-Boss Uprising & Full Roster Completion
chapters.notes: Clear Arcade mode on Medium difficulty (default settings, no character change) with each of the 8 unlocked sub-bosses. Execute their respective 6-hit combos. Clearing Arcade without continues unlocks Heihachi Mishima, officially completing the entire 17-character roster.

chapters.title: The Mishima Zaibatsu: Heihachi Campaign & Mastery
chapters.notes: Select Heihachi Mishima and conquer Arcade mode on Medium difficulty without changing characters. Perform Heihachi's 6-hit combo or 10-hit string to master the King of Iron Fist.

chapters.title: Master of the Iron Fist: Hard, Speedrun & Marathon Trials
chapters.notes: Complete the specialty challenge runs: defeat Arcade on Ultra Hard (also satisfies Hard), execute a sub-5 minute Arcade speedrun using Michelle (10-hit combo cheese) or Lee, and conquer the Long Journey 5-round marathon on Medium+ without continues or character switching.
